title: Useful Food
description: Removes the vanilla saturation cap and prevents wasted food by converting overflow hunger points into additional saturation.
body:
Useful Food fixes the frustration of wasting food in Minecraft by making the hunger system more logical.

Overflow Conversion: Any food points that go over the 20-point limit are automatically converted into saturation instead of being lost.

Uncapped Saturation: It removes the vanilla restriction that forces your saturation level to stay below your hunger level.

Extended Reserves: Saturation can now climb up to 40 points, allowing for much longer periods of health regeneration and sprinting before you need to eat again.
